target: fixed selected-catalogue linear estimator covariance with all windows stacked
owner: HTT model-dependent uncertainty consumption; obsstat extraction supplies A

A.semantics: exact fixed science extraction response, including actual nuisance treatment and all depth windows

independent_variance.semantics: nonnegative independent remainder, excluding every component represented by other terms

correlated_factor.semantics: qualified physical or explicitly conditional latent factor V; VV^T is input correlated covariance

calibration_response.semantics: K maps calibration parameters to output, with same source order/units/frame

calibration_covariance.semantics: symmetric PSD covariance with named calibration parameter ordering

ownership.semantics: disjoint physical uncertainty-source labels; supplied source provenance must justify completeness and lack of cross-group correlation

required_checks_before_physical_use: Reproduce original diagonal producer from matching A and noise ownership
Bind source positions/distances and ICRS/frame/time labels
Account once for the inherited 250 km/s term
Retain or jointly factor cross-group error covariance
Register latent-factor approximation error if approximate
Calibrate repeat-estimator selection/weight effects when target is not conditional on fixed design
Validate the declared null/statistic law and scan protocol
next_action: Local producer exports source-bound A or equivalent streamed row-response blocks; qualified source-law factors consumed without re-running completed summary fits
